items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses 'Milt' directly ('I know you'd be interested to know, Milt', 'Milt, we went to great lengths...'), indicating familiarity, but no specific professional or personal relationship details (like collaboration, friendship, or mentorship) are provided in the text.

ctx.x: I think you explained that beautifully, Cliff. That must have been quite some scene; I can just see all those dudes grabbing you, thinking, well, okay, here goes a piano player. That was quite funny -- and I'm glad you still have that meat cleaver.
I know you'd be interested to know, Milt,

that our bass player -- I forgot to mention him, was Billy Taylor, Jr., he was a young man then with a wonderful talent, and I'm sure you would agree with me. That's before he moved to Washington, D.C. -- and in the past year or so, he passed away.
